note: The lines of the app's shell that a narrator voices (docs/audio/release-voicing-plan.md, F3). The words are the voice_text of the strings named here, in docs/review/hebrew-master.csv (one place for the editor, one status for the owner). A line with perLand is voiced once for each land in lands, with {land} replaced by the land's voice name, as <id>.<land key>. The ids are the ones the app asks for in app/lib/child/adventure_line.dart (core.adventure.*); core.languages.doors_hello and core.home.bubble_empty are new ids that the app does not ask for yet.
